title: Chest-tube access rehearsal
scope: Landmark identification and localized layered chest-tube rehearsal with blunt training instruments on a synthetic mannequin surface only

workflow.title: Approach and landmark alignment
workflow.instruction: Align the scalpel with the lateral intercostal window without contacting protected rib geometry.

workflow.title: Controlled skin incision
workflow.instruction: Lower the scalpel until skin deforms, then travel the highlighted corridor.

workflow.title: Blunt soft-tissue dissection
workflow.instruction: Switch to the blunt dissector and open the subcutaneous and muscle tract.

workflow.title: Controlled pleural-layer entry
workflow.instruction: Enter the pleural layer only after the soft-tissue tract is open.

workflow.title: Tube placement
workflow.instruction: Place the chest tube through the simulated tract.

workflow.title: Completion and scorecard
workflow.instruction: Review deterministic metrics. This is training telemetry, not a clinical score.

target.description: Illustrative lateral-chest intercostal target to be reviewed against locally approved triangle-of-safety teaching guidance. Not on the centre or front of the chest.
